chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Many a single eating prevents several eatings.
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of moderate eating according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this concise maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) illustrates the principle of satiety, noting that one meal can suppress the desire for many others, thereby curbing gluttony. This teaching aligns with the Shia scholarly emphasis on *wasatiyyah* (moderation) in physical consumption, linking bodily discipline to spiritual clarity and the prevention of the soul's attachment to worldly pleasures.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 171. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
Many a single eating prevents several eatings. [1]
